messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: planning to enable per-org flag `advanced_inference` for Acme (org_id=acme-123) tomorrow 10:00am PT. Scope: per_org + contract_tier=enterprise + explicit allowlist. Rollout I propose: 5% for 30m -> 40% for 90m -> 100% if healthy. Any missing guardrails? :eyes:

rajesh: Backend safety nets exist: we block ramps if p95 latency > 600ms over a 10m window or 5xx rate > 1%. Also enforcing per-tenant concurrency cap and queue depth. Double-check batching config so we don't accidentally change batch sizes during canary.

olivia: Quick question: will this toggle clear or bypass any prompt KV caches? If callers rely on cached prefixes we could see quality/consistency diffs when org flips.

cheng: I opened runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4580

cheng: Toggle payload I'm pushing to toggle-service (format below):
```json
{
  "flag": "advanced_inference",
  "scope": "per_org",
  "org_allowlist": ["acme-123"],
  "contract_constraints": ["enterprise"],
  "rollout": [
    {"pct": 5, "duration_min": 30},
    {"pct": 40, "duration_min": 90},
    {"pct": 100, "duration_min": 0}
  ],
  "auto_rollback": {
    "5xx_rate_pct": 1.0,
    "latency_ms_p95": 600,
    "max_queue_share_pct": 10
  },
  "fallback_route": "runtime-small-v1"
}
```

deploy-bot: Toggle change scheduled by maya for 2024-06-06T17:00:00Z (toggle-service v2.9.0). Runbook: /runbooks/per-org-feature-flags

katie: I'll own alerting during rollout. If we hit 5xx > 0.75% or p95 > 600ms i'll escalate. Tagging #eng-oncall for visibility. :mag:

maya: Rajesh, can you confirm the fallback is a hard route swap to `runtime-small-v1` (not a soft degrade)? Need guaranteed failover when thresholds hit.

rajesh: Confirmed. Router service will perform an atomic route swap back to the fallback variant. Added one more safety: stop ramps for that org if it accounts for >10% of global queue length for >2m. Also added an integration test exercising hard-failover.

olivia: I'll run a targeted eval set on Acme prompts during the 5% window and post diffs here. Will also check for any downstream cache invalidation effects.

cheng: @alex can you do a quick CR on the runtime changes? PR #4580 includes the toggle wiring + integration tests. Need an approval before we flip.

alex: On it — will review and aim to merge today EOD. Ping me if CI flakes.

maya: Final prep checklist for tomorrow: 1) PR merged to main, 2) runbook reviewed & linked, 3) katie monitoring alerts, 4) olivia running evals during canary, 5) deploy-bot scheduled toggle. Reply here when each item is done. :white_check_mark:

rajesh: Added ticket with thresholds + test link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/RW-7922

olivia: Note: small cache invalidation job will run at toggle time (cheng added step to toggle-service). I'll publish evaluation results after the 5% window.

alex: PR reviewed & merged, CI green.

deploy-bot: Toggle executed (advanced_inference -> enabled for acme-123 @ 2024-06-06T17:00:00Z).
